title: Collections and Data Modelling
introduction: Collections store many related values, while a data model describes what those values mean together.
learningOutcomes: Choose between sequence, set and key-value collections.
Model a small domain using related fields and constraints.

activities.question: Which collection best maps a unique username to a profile?
activities.explanation: A map retrieves a value using a unique key such as a username.

activities.question: A set is useful when each value should occur at most once.
activities.explanation: Sets model membership and prevent duplicate values.

activities.question: A collection whose elements have a stable position is commonly called a ___.
activities.explanation: Lists and other sequences retain an order and normally support position-based access.
